question: Largest native-density ROI that fits 180 messages (288 B) as nrjxl and is >= today's pjpg (Nick via EM, 2026-10-03)
host: nereus002 (Pi Zero 2 W, IMX708 imx708_wide, Debian 13, rpicam-apps 1.12)

capture.command: python3 scripts/capture_raw_imx708.py --stops 0 --repeat 3 (worktree copy; the Pi checkout predates --repeat)
capture.scene: room, card V1 + Pixel Perfect checker on a box at ~1.5 m; plastic-wrap glare over the card's left half

raw_files.note: NOT committed (*.dng/*.jpg are git-ignored). Copies: nereus002:~/s28_presets/sweep_20261003T203525Z/ and the Mac worktree's runs folder.

encoder.source: bm_cam_legacy PR #120 (feature/sprint28-camera) head bd6f38c, BM_Devel_Pi/rc_raw_jxl.py sha256 4abc585674eccb75…, rc_jpeg_encoder.py 15e4739dac5f32cb…
encoder.cjxl: modular, effort 5, one thread; Pi cjxl v0.11.2
encoder.note: Mac and Pi produce identical bytes for the same crop + distance

pi_bench.wrapper: pi_time.py (RLIMIT_AS 700 MiB outer cap, nice 10; cjxl keeps the production 250 MiB guard)

steps: python -m compression_study.presets.roi_sweep --run <this> --prod <BM_Devel_Pi> --frames 0 1 2  → sweep.csv, pjpg.csv, patches.json, sweep_meta.json, slides/ (git-ignored PNGs)

python -m compression_study.presets.roi_sweep --run <this> --prod <BM_Devel_Pi> --frames 0 --suffix _r0render  → re-render of frame 0 slides after the highlight-clip fix (numbers identical to sweep.csv frame 0)
python ~/.claude/skills/before-after-report/scripts/build_report.py sheet/spec.json sheet/index.html --split  → sheet/index.html + index_img/ (PNGs git-ignored)
card_location: rois_r0.json from sweep_rois.find_rois_quad: tags 1/3 decoded (ArUco on the JPEG), tags 0/2 placed from their dark borders (glare blocks decoding); tagcentres_r*.npy per frame agree within 0.5 px
answer: 1600x900 (d 3.81, 178 msgs): core SSIM 0.970 vs pjpg 0.935, card dE 1.28 vs 2.68; Pi Zero 8.5 s / 40 MiB. 2000x1124 and 2304x1296 fit but WARN on detail; 3072x1728 needs 189 msgs at d 15; full frame does not fit and trips the 250 MiB guard (~260 MiB, ESTIMATE).

step_a_levers.question: Do cjxl effort 7 or the 195-message production cap move 2000x1124 / 2304x1296 from WARN to PASS within encode <= 30 s and RSS <= 150 MiB on the Zero?
step_a_levers.pi: pi_time.py NAME CROP D STEM OUT EFFORT on nereus002 (frame 0, frame-0 distances) → pi_levers.txt
step_a_levers.answer: Only e7 at 195 msgs lifts 2000x1124 to PASS (marginal: acutance 1.05 vs pjpg 1.04+0.02); 2304x1296 stays WARN (acutance 0.90-0.93). Zero: max 19.4 s / 63 MiB (2304 e7), all 12 within budget.
